latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator from Photo skill:

- Instantly turns your uploaded photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into animated 1080p MP4 videos.
- No account required: anonymous token grants 100 free credits for fast, cloud-based video creation (30–60 sec per job).
- Supports multiple photo uploads, timeline editing, text overlays, BGM, aspect ratio changes, and easy export.
- Clear workflows for uploading, editing, previewing, and downloading your video.
- Simple error handling, session management, and helpful status/credit queries built-in.
